questions.question: Seven years from now, Anamika will be as old as Malini was 4 years ago. Srinidhi was born 2 years ago. The average age of Anamika, Malini and Srinidhi 10 years from now will be 33 years. What is the present age of Anamika?
questions.solution:
Let the present age of Anamika be A, Malini be M and that of Srinidhi be S.

The, according to the question:

1) Seven years from now, Anamika will be as old as Malini was 4 years ago. 

A + 7 = M - 4

⇒ M = A + 11

S = 2 years

And, 

2) Srinidhi was born 2 years ago. The average age of Anamika, Malini and Srinidhi 10 years from now will be 33 years.

{(A + 10 + M + 10 + S + 10) over 3} = 33 

A + M + S + 30 = 33 times 3

A + M + S = 99 - 30

A + M + S = 69 

Now, by substituting the above values,

A + (A + 11) + 2 = 69 

2A + 13 = 69

A = 56 ÷ 2

A = 28 years

Hence, the present age of Anamika is **28 years **is the correct answer.

(12, 30, 61)

Select the correct combination of mathematical signs that can sequentially replace the * signs and balance the equation.

60 * 2 * 3 * 6 * 5 * 43
questions.solution:
Apply BODMAS rule -

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ede1d5895e07ace4025c0d55de23c8b6ac6260bcd2d37be659a9bdb0d61009f.png] 

From option 1 -

60 ÷ 2 × 3 + 6 - 5 = 43

30 × 3 + 6 - 5 = 43

90 + 6 - 5 = 43

96 - 5 = 43

91 ≈ 43, It does not follow.

From option 2 -

60 ÷ 2 + 3 × 6 = 5 - 43

30 + 3 × 6 = 5 - 43

30 + 18 = 5 - 43

48 ≈ -38, It does not follow.

**From option 3 -**

**60 ÷ 2 + 3 × 6 - 5 = 43**

**30 + 3 × 6 - 5 = 43**

**30 + 18 - 5 = 43**

**48 - 5 = 43**

**43 = 43, It follows.**

From option 4 -

60 + 2 ÷ 3 × 6 = 5 - 43

60 + 0.67 × 6 = 5 - 43

60 + 4.02 = 5 - 43

64.02 ≈ -38, It does not follow.

Hence, **"option 3"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All directors are actors.

No actor is a producer.

All choreographers are directors.

**Conclusions:**

I. No choreographer is producer.

II. Some actors are choreographers.

III. No director is a producer.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/664910d9eac82526af4163f4def62d9b6014bdd02a3f08a8854a03c4af03fbbf.png] 

I. No choreographer is producer. - True (All choreographer is a actor and no actor is a producer then no choreographers is producer is follow.)

II. Some actors are choreographers. True (If All choreographers are actors then some actors are choreographer. So some actors are choreographers is follow.)

III. No director is a producer. True (All choreographer is a directors and all directors are actors then the relation is same between choreographer and producer, director and producer and actor and producer. So no director is a producer is follow.)

Hence, **"option 1"** is the correct answer.

questions.solution: From figure I and II we take common letter E, then take clock wise direction from the common point E. A is opposite to 9, I is opposite to O, and E is opposite to U. And, from II and III we take common letter 9, then take clock wise direction from the common point 9. O is opposite to I, E is opposite to U, and 9 is opposite to A. Similarly, from III and I we take common letter I, then take clock wise direction from the common point I. U is opposite to E, 9 is opposite to A, and I is opposite to O.
